releaseDisposition: 0.4 experimental; preserve Nov6 deferral; no0.3 gate

benchmark.resultAdmission: Existing benchmark schemas remain calibration-only; this plan is not an admitted model result.

selection.reason: Inspected root/list/trigger/content criteria and mapped existing tests; exercises focus versus selection, disabled traversal, accessible relationships and host removal without overlay, compiler or Adapter prerequisites.
selection.limits: One public primitive does not support ecosystem-wide claims; other candidate names are not automatic admission.

task.extension: Host action count and exact target/source layout are ordinary information shared across all arms.

conditions.intent: Practical mature-library delivery; use Radix Tabs1.1.13 public APIs, not the already-authored example as a timed participant result.
conditions.additionalMaterial: Same permitted public target ecosystem information; no Proto knowledge.
conditions.exposureRequirement: Retain exact supplied material and actual retrieval/access log.

conditions.intent: AI ordinary requirements plus permitted public ecosystem material; method remains flexible.
conditions.withheld: Proto criteria/contracts/knowledge, repository implementation, example and evaluator.
conditions.exposureRequirement: Retain actual supplied and read bytes; same public target info as knowledge condition.

conditions.intent: Same task and allowed implementation choices as unassisted, plus declared interaction facts.
conditions.withheld: Final Proto implementation, generated output, clean example and evaluator.
conditions.exposureRequirement: Retain supplied/read bytes and stable source references; missing access is a handoff deviation.

targets.browser: Actual Chromium binary/version and hash must be retained
targets.lock: Direct pins authored; a transitive lock must be generated, retained and frozen before any measured cell.

pairedControls: Task/prompt structure and permitted ordinary material
Target framework, dependency lock, browser and OS image
Independent evaluator and frozen check/severity/conflict policy

operatorAdmission.modelManifest: Not supplied; Main must record the actual configured participant before any run. No backend identity is inferred.
operatorAdmission.budgets: Not selected or spent; choose and freeze an equal affordable budget before both AI conditions.
operatorAdmission.isolation: Unavailable in the current shared repository; public case cannot become held-out or strict blind.
operatorAdmission.oracle: check.mjs is a public consumer observation candidate awaiting independent review, not an admitted formal oracle.
operatorAdmission.formalRepeatSource: Existing dataset formalPolicy.minimumIndependentRepeats; no36+9 or effect-size gate.
operatorAdmission.counterbalance: Rotate library/unassisted/knowledge order across repetitions when practical; retain actual order and deviations.

optionalRepresentationControl.condition: Same independently reviewed facts and target/API/examples in readable documentation versus a source-mapped projection; freeze size, retrieval cost and actual access.
optionalRepresentationControl.claimBoundary: No representation claim without this control; deterministic realization remains owned by#749/#732.

measurements: Exact raw task outputs and first/final source snapshots
First-pass and final behavioral/accessibility/host/cleanup check vectors
Initially omitted and unsupported invented requirements
Defects with severity/type/first divergence and independent authority
Tokens, compute, elapsed/human time and monetary cost, or unavailable with reason
Observed maintenance/change work, dependencies/version sensitivity and unmeasured longer-term burden
Every failed, aborted, omitted, excluded and deviating run
Per-cell distribution/run variance and paired differences; no opaque aggregate score

interpretation.reason: No comparison has run; supported/weakened/inconclusive/falsified belongs to actual collected evidence.
